title: WARNING! SENSITIVE SUBJECT! Good for something else, just not composting.
text: WARNING! SENSITIVE SUBJECT! Good for something else, just not composting.. I used this for a couple of weeks in my kitchen. I don't have a compost pile, but when I found out it takes over a year to make compost, it lost its appeal for that purpose. Instead, I'm using it as a small trash pail next to the toilet in my bathroom. It's the perfect size to use every month. (Sorry for being gross, but it's the truth, Ruth!)

product_metadata.title: HOMWE Kitchen Compost Bin for Countertop or Under Sink Composting, 1.3 Gallon, Indoor Home Trash Can with Removable Airtight Lid, Storage Hook Hanger, Black Plastic
features: Airtight, Odor-Locking Lid – HOMWE compost bins come with a precision-fit lid that helps keep odors in and flies out. The retention ring also helps keep your recyclable or biodegradable bags from sliding down or bunching up.
Compact Kitchen Size - At 1.3 gallons this small, portable compost bin for kitchen countertop use is just the right size for everyday clean up without taking up space or feeling like a big trashcan.

Top Rack Dishwasher Safe and BPA Free – We use a high-quality, BPA-free plastic that’s stain and odor resistant, easy to wash, and comes with a flip-up carry handle to make it easier to use around the kitchen or take outside to your garden.

Counter or Mounted Storage Design（Fit Max Cabinet door Thickness 0.8"） – Each 9.5” x 7.5” x 5.7” kitchen compost bin can be placed on the counter or hung from the inside of a cabinet with the included hook hanger, so you can save space and keep your kitchen organized.

Multipurpose Waste Container – Our compost kitchen bin also makes a quick trash can for your camping trip, RV, bathroom, or underneath your desk. Use it for tossing away trash, paper, candy wrappers, or other small day-to-day junk.
